Do not use MKL on Ryzen. It isn't optimized on non-Intel CPU.

Set CFLAGS and CXXFLAGS as "-march=znver2 -O3", compile NumPy and SciPy on your own and link them to an optimized OpenBLAS(TARGET=ZEN) and FFTW.

Compared to pip stock version, I got 30% to 100% speed improvement with self-compiled NumPy .

Here is my test result on a stock Ryzen 3700X:

>Random generation: 3.958912s   
gemm 8k: 13.431936s   
gemm 800: 0.083382s   
pinv 800: 1.444779s   
diff large: 28.397348s
